name: zuma
title: zuma · anonymous subnets on Starknet + NEAR
description: A zk approach to Bittensor-style subnets on TWO chains: miners and validators are public SETS, but every action is a scope-linkable ring signature (LSAG over the STARK curve). A Cairo contract verifies it natively on Starknet; a Rust/wasm contract verifies the SAME signatures on NEAR. A validator scores a miner's per-epoch tag without knowing which miner it is; a miner is scored without knowing which validator scored it.

protocol.scheme: LSAG (Liu-Wei-Wong) over the STARK curve, Poseidon challenges, key image I = x * Hp(scope)
protocol.miner_tag: key image under scope H('zuma-mine', subnet, epoch): one submission per miner per epoch, unlinkable across epochs
protocol.validator_nullifier: key image under scope H('zuma-score', subnet, epoch, tag): one score per validator per tag, unlinkable across tags
protocol.claim: after the epoch, the miner re-signs in the epoch scope (same image = same tag) and credits emission * tag_sum / epoch_total to any recipient
protocol.anonymity_set: min_ring (on-chain) <= ring <= 64 on Starknet, <= 32 on NEAR (gas-bound: ~7.5 Tgas/member); strictly sorted key ids so rings cannot be padded
protocol.relayer: contract never checks the caller; actions are posted by a relayer account because the tx sender is public
protocol.contract: contracts/ (Starknet: Scarb package zuma, snforge tests) + near/ (NEAR: near-sdk 5 crate zuma_near, cargo tests incl. Cairo fixtures)
protocol.prover: prover/ (Cairo program linking the same lsag module; scarb cairo-run)

toolchain.rust: stable + wasm32-unknown-unknown, RUSTFLAGS -C target-cpu=mvp --cfg near, then tools/wasmlower

networks.sepolia: sncast account (STRK-funded) via account=, rpc= or ZUMA_RPC_SEPOLIA
networks.mainnet: sncast account (STRK-funded) via account=, rpc= or ZUMA_RPC_MAINNET
networks.near: local near-sandbox on :51333 (root test.near; relayer/payee sub-accounts)
networks.near-testnet: NEAR testnet via the near module keystore (~/.mod/near/keys.json), account=

state: data/keys.json (0600, member secrets, never leave the box), data/deployments.json, data/devnet/ — all gitignored
console: static/index.html served by server.py: chain switch STARKNET|NEAR, LIVE ring stage + run/replay an anonymous epoch on either chain, CODE (both codebases, verifier side by side), COMPARE (costs + NEAR gas by ring size), TESTS, WHITEPAPER. Reads + sandbox simulate are public; anything touching member keys is loopback-only.
